reason: Runtime-created independent ordinary Hermes peer windows, with local state factories and explicit creation receipts.
patch_notes: Event-thread dynamic ordinary hosts, private single-consumption queue and explicit creation receipts; action transaction propagation.
Live hosts use a map with never-reused routing IDs; ordinary peers outlive the creating window and release closed host state.
Physical geometry/maximization request and a local close-request veto; global Quit/OS termination veto remains application-level work.
Existing macOS native-help test is gated to its actual platform so the Linux unit harness compiles.
Timer-driven close/hide publishes current AppHandle visibility; real native opener-close acceptance exposed the missing publication.
Opt-in display-change callback reports visible input composition without changing committed-text callbacks.
Opt-in scoped highlight reveal traverses vertical scroll ancestors for transcript search.
Opt-in post-commit mounted-node lifetime callback supports independent virtualized transcript audio resources.
Cached Markdown parser link occurrences retain authored source and rendered label byte ranges.
Opt-in Markdown authored-link replacements render fresh elements in separate rows between styled fragments.
Markdown library test renderer fixtures initialize the embedded-block accumulator consistently with production.
Ordered multiple-folder native and scripted selection with cancellation and window-owned delivery.
